In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
As and Se are two anionic elements that play different roles in Chinese brake fern.
the uptake and transportation of cationic elements in Chinese brake fern are closely related to the uptake and transportation processes of the anionic elements As and Se.
the uptake of As in Chinese brake fern is not a simple process but rather a complex and dynamic process involving multiple elements and factors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
As and other cations are transported and accumulated by different mechanisms.
the anionic elements (Br, Se and As) and the cationic elements (La, Sm and K) are the key elements that affect As uptake and translocation in Chinese brake fern.
As, Se, K, Na, and other cationic and anionic elements are positively correlated in Chinese brake fern at ZMD and LMC.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the interrelationship of elements in the fern should be considered when using it as a bioindicator of environmental contamination or a phytoremediator of heavy metal contamination.
the anionic elements (As, Se and Br) play different roles in the uptake and transportation of cationic elements.

Chinese brake fern can accumulate high concentrations of As and other elements simultaneously, and the correlation between these elements may provide a new clue to the understanding of the mechanism of As uptake and accumulation in this fern species.
